message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with white and black line art depicting nine men and several text elements. At the top, the word "TEMPO" is prominent in white.

Two men at the top appear as protesters: one with a raised fist and another holding a megaphone. They wear headbands and light-colored shirts. Below them, three men in similar shirts hold red placards with the white letters "R," "E," and "O." At the bottom, four men in dark suits and ties hold red placards bearing "M," "A," "$," and "I." Collectively, the letters on the placards spell "RE FORM A$I." Some men in the bottom row wear sunglasses and rings.

Visible text on the left includes: "SETELAH 25 TAHUN" and "Cita-cita Reformasi 1998 tak tercapai. Para aktivis di luar dan di dalam kekuasaan gagal mencegah kembalinya watak otoritarianisme. H.34". At the top, "LIPUTAN KHUSUS" is printed, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below "TEMPO." A barcode, QR code, and pricing information are in the upper right.
